title: Edge component of a sampled occurrence lies in the graph
statement: Let $s$ be a state of the contraction process, with underlying multigraph $G$, and let $(e, k)$ be any element of the sample space of edge occurrences of $s$ — a pair consisting of an edge together with an index distinguishing parallel copies. Then the edge $e$ is a member of the edge multiset of $G$.
hypotheses_covered: s is a state of the contraction process (with underlying multigraph G)
(e,k) is an element of the edge-occurrence sample space of s
replaced:
The first projection of any element of the occurrence sample space of $s$ is an edge of
$s.G$.
